name: show_slide
description: Put one slide on the screen that answers the question just asked or matches the new topic. Use ONLY facts from {{context_pack}}. Call it instead of speaking.

trigger.description: The question or topic you heard, in the speaker's words, as one short sentence.

title.description: Slide title, at most 6 words, taken from the context pack.

bullets.description: 0 to 3 bullets, each at most 12 words, each stated in the context pack.

stat.description: Optional single headline number from the context pack. Omit if there is none.

value.description: The number as shown, e.g. "$49" or "18".

label.description: What the number is, at most 5 words.

imageId.description: Optional id of an image from the IMAGES list (e.g. "i3") that fits the slide. Omit if none fits.

sourceIds.description: Ids of the chunks and images the content came from, e.g. ["c4", "i2"].

items.description: A chunk id (c…) or image id (i…).

name: log_followup
description: The context pack does not answer the question. Record it for the follow-up email instead of inventing an answer. Never show a slide for it.

question.description: The question as asked, one sentence.

name: capture_email
description: After the pitch ends and the visitor has confirmed their spelled-back email, save it with a short summary of the conversation.

email.description: The confirmed email address, lowercase, no spaces.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the visitor was interested in and what is still open.
